verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity documents its own conversion-optimized ID capture flow. Its web integration includes camera use, and a community user reports that image analysis runs in the browser without a native app. This shows a web capture flow, but the evidence is thin on the specific story elements. Missing for 10: documented native iOS and Android SDKs, explicit glare/blur/edge-detection coaching during capture, and evidence of first-try usable photo rates.

support.subject: As a developer, I get native iOS, Android, and web SDKs with guided camera capture — glare, blur, and edge detection coaching the user to a usable document photo on the first try

citations.quote: Capture government-issued photo IDs with a conversion-optimized verification flow
It does all the image analysis in browser without the need for a native app.
